---
title: "Exploratory Spatial Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
```

```{r}
res_dir <- here("data", "Resilience")
out_dir <- here("outputs", "01_explore")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

months <- c("MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP")
```

```{r}
res_stack <- rast(file.path(res_dir, paste0("Resilience", months, ".tif")))
names(res_stack) <- months
res_stack

global(res_stack, "notNA")
```

```{r}
n_years <- 38

tau_crit <- function(n, alpha = 0.05) {
  var_s <- n * (n - 1) * (2 * n + 5) / 18
  qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * sqrt(var_s) / (n * (n - 1) / 2)
}
tc <- tau_crit(n_years)
tc
```

```{r}
tau_long <- lapply(months, function(m) {
  data.frame(month = m,
             tau = as.vector(values(res_stack[[m]], na.rm = TRUE)))
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = months))

nrow(tau_long)
```

```{r}
tau_summary <- tau_long |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    pixels           = n(),
    hectares         = n() * 0.09,
    mean_tau         = mean(tau),
    median_tau       = median(tau),
    pct_declining    = 100 * mean(tau < 0),
    pct_zero         = 100 * mean(tau == 0),
    pct_sig_decline  = 100 * mean(tau < -tc),
    pct_sig_increase = 100 * mean(tau > tc)
  )
tau_summary

write.csv(tau_summary, file.path(out_dir, "tau_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
p_hist <- ggplot(tau_long, aes(x = tau)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.02) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-tc, tc), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ month, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Kendall's tau (trend in surface water)", y = "Pixels",
       title = "Trend values by month (dashed = approx. significance)")
p_hist

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tau_histograms.png"), p_hist, width = 6, height = 8)
```

```{r}
blanca <- vect(here("data", "boundaries", "blanca_core.shp")) |>
  project(crs(res_stack))

res_blanca <- crop(res_stack, ext(blanca) + 500)   # 500 m margin

plot(res_blanca$JUN, col = pal, range = c(-0.72, 0.72),
     maxcell = Inf, colNA = "grey92", main = "June trend, Blanca")
lines(blanca, lwd = 1.5)
```
```{r}
trend_class <- classify(res_stack, rcl = matrix(c(
  -Inf, -tc, 1,
  -tc,   tc, 2,
   tc,  Inf, 3), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE))

jun_class <- trend_class$JUN
levels(jun_class) <- data.frame(value = 1:3,
  trend = c("Significant decline", "No clear trend", "Significant increase"))

jun_class_blanca <- crop(jun_class, ext(blanca) + 500)   # 500 m margin

plot(jun_class_blanca, col = c("#B2182B", "grey85", "#2166AC"),
     main = "June trend class")

writeRaster(trend_class, file.path(out_dir, "trend_class.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
n_obs      <- sum(!is.na(res_stack))
n_sig_decl <- sum(res_stack < -tc, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sig_decl <- mask(n_sig_decl, n_obs, maskvalues = 0)

freq(n_sig_decl)

plot(crop(n_sig_decl, blanca),
     col = c("grey85", hcl.colors(5, "OrRd", rev = TRUE)),
     type = "classes", maxcell = Inf, colNA = "grey92",
     main = "Months with significant decline, Blanca core")
```
